name: JW Marriott Hotel Nara
positioning: Japan's first JW Marriott, a city-center luxury hotel near Nara Park with a spa inspired by Nara's Tenpyo-era temples
best_for: Travelers exploring Nara Park, Todaiji Temple and Nara's heritage sites
Guests who want a spa, indoor pool and daily morning yoga in the city center

facts.text: The hotel is the first JW Marriott in Japan.
It is the first international luxury hotel in Nara city center.
The hotel is located near Nara Park.
The Heijo Palace Site and Todaiji Temple are nearby.
All rooms and suites feature Aromatherapy Associates bath amenities.
All guest rooms are equipped with rain showers.
The spa offers massages and facials using Aromatherapy Associates products.
The spa includes a steam room and sauna.
All staying guests have access to the indoor pool, jacuzzi and a 24-hour fitness center.
Azekura, the Japanese restaurant, has separate teppanyaki, sushi and kaiseki dining areas.
Silk Road Dining, the all-day restaurant, serves world cuisines from an open kitchen, inspired by Nara having been the final stop on the Silk Road.
The hotel hosts a morning session every day that combines stretching, yoga and meditation.

highlights.text: Guest rooms use warm orange and natural earth tones as a tribute to Nara's traditional Wakakusa Yamayaki festival.
Spa by JW is designed to represent the serenity and purity of the Tenpyo-era temple architecture in and around Nara.
Through an Artist-in-Residence Program, works by Nara-based artist Chiharu Yoshina are displayed in the lobby and Flying Stag.
The famous Nara deer motif is used as inspiration in the guest rooms.
The on-site JW Garden sources fresh herbs and vegetables used across the hotel's dining.

considerations.text: Nara is just over 30 minutes by train from Kyoto and Osaka.
The hotel connects by bridge to the adjacent Nara Convention Center.
WhataHotel notes limited nightlife options in historic Nara.
